text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Dinner with the family for the first time 
in ages~! And I get presents, birthdays 
are the absolute best! Ehehe~, big sisss♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, loungewear from me! You wanted the 
limited collaboration color, right? Cheval 
has one for you too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Um, well... Mine isn't really 
something worthy of being called a 
present...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all, is it? You were 
thinking about it so earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't have good taste like Big 
Sis does... So I'm not really sure if I 
picked out the right thing...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay!! I'm the star today! I'm taking 
eeevery single present!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The fish lure you gave me before is super 
cute, so I put it on display! And I've 
been taking good care of my glove, too! If 
you don't give me one this year, I'm gonna 
pout! *Poke, poke!*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh... ah... y-you cherish it that 
much...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Going fishing, playing catch, all of 
it! Whenever you ask me to join, 
Cheval-chi, it makes me super happy, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's right, just like the ocean photo 
book you gave me. I really enjoyed sharing 
our thoughts on it. I love your taste, 
Cheval! Have more confidence!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...This year... um, a fishing rod... You 
said it looked cool, so... I thought a 
matching one might be nice, unless you'd 
hate that...?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
N-No way would I hate that! Let's go 
fishing in matching outfits! 
Che~va~l-chan~!
